sourceText:
Raw Italian Cauliflower Salad Recipe [Paleo, Keto, AIP]
By: Paleo Flourish
Published: Thursday, August 16, 2018 - 9:28pm

Ingredients




7 oz (200 g) cauliflower florets, chopped into halves or quarters
2 Tablespoons (30 ml) olive oil
2 teaspoons (10 ml) lemon juice
3 Tablespoons parsley, chopped
4 olives, pitted and diced
1 clove of garlic, minced
Salt and pepper to taste (omit pepper for AIP)

Preparation

1 Mix all the ingredients together and toss well.

About

DESCRIPTION: This raw cauliflower salad is super fast and easy to make and enjoy.
